description: Updates the user's Chop it pantry from what they've bought, have or used up: add items (topping up existing ones), remove by name, or change or remove exact rows by pantryItemId. On add, location places stock directly in pantry, fridge or freezer; only compatible items in that location are topped up. Omit unknown quantities or expiry dates rather than guessing. Read back before retrying a top-up, which is additive. An ambiguous item returns its candidates without changing that item; other unambiguous items in the request can still change. Staples such as salt, pepper and oil are skipped. Edits the same pantry the app shows. Requires a linked Chop it account.

add.description: Items to add (or top up when already present).

expiryDate.description: ISO date the item should be used by, if known.

location.description: Use the location the user identifies. Omit only when unknown; then the usual storage location is inferred.

name.description: Ingredient name, UK vocabulary (coriander, courgette, mince).

remove.description: Ingredient names to remove; matched on the same canonical key the app uses.

removeItemIds.description: Exact pantryItemIds from get_pantry to delete. Preferred for duplicate names.

update.description: Set fields on an exact row; quantity replaces rather than adds.

name: update_pantry
title: Update the pantry
